books.title: Xenos
books.summary: In 240.M41 Eisenhorn kills the murderer Murdin Eyclone on Hubris and follows his trail to House Glaw on Gudrun, where he is captured and tortured before Voke's purge. He chases the surviving cabal to Damask and KCX-1288, destroys the Necroteuch they meant to buy from the saruthi, and takes the psy-engram of Pontius Glaw. An Inquisitorial strike on 56-Izar destroys the saruthi copy and unmasks Molitor and the daemonhost Cherubael.

books.title: Malleus
books.summary: A century later, after the Thracian Atrocity frees 33 captive alpha-plus psykers and cripples Ravenor, Eisenhorn traces the conspiracy through the traitor Lyko and Cherubael to the long-vanished renegade Quixos. Osma arrests him on Cadia and declares him Extremis Diabolus. Freed by his retinue, he consults Pontius Glaw on Cinchare, forms a cell of inquisitors, and kills Quixos on Farness Beta, then secretly binds Cherubael anew with the Malus Codicium.

books.title: Hereticus
books.summary: In 386.M41 Eisenhorn finally kills Midas Betancore's murderer, but only by unleashing Cherubael, and Bequin is left brain-dead. Pontius Glaw, escaped in a mechanical body, wipes out Eisenhorn's network, and the Inquisition outlaws him again. Fischig betrays him, and Aemos and Maxilla die. With Ravenor's help Eisenhorn reaches Ghül, where he destroys the Malus Codicium and kills Glaw.

books.title: Missing in Action
books.summary: In 241.M41, on the declining world of Sameter, Eisenhorn looks into ritual murders in the hive city of Urbitane at the request of its Minister of Security. The "cult" turns out to be traumatised Imperial Guard veterans who believe Chaos has infiltrated their world. Eisenhorn breaks them up but must kill several and loses his left hand.

books.title: Backcloth for a Crown Additional
books.summary: In 355.M41 on Gudrun, a friend's death "of fright" leads Eisenhorn and Bequin to a travelling fair. They find that a hololithographer's warp-tainted fixer is killing people and trapping their ghosts in portraits. Eisenhorn smashes the vial with Barbarisater, but the old portraitist Bakunin is dragged into the warp.

books.title: Ravenor
books.summary: On Eustis Majoris, Inquisitor Ravenor and his band investigate flects, warp-tainted glass sold as a drug, picking up the boy psyker Zael along the way. The trail leads via Flint into Lucky Space, where Ministry of Sub-Sector Trade agents Kinsky, Madsen and Ahenobarb betray him at Bonner's Reach. Surviving, Ravenor learns of Contract Thirteen, a cartel smuggling tainted cogitators from the Mergent Worlds, and returns to Eustis Majoris in secret while presumed dead.

books.title: Thorn Wishes Talon
books.summary: A coded summons draws Ravenor to Malinter, where his team battles the Divine Fratery cult and a Chaos Dreadnought. His mysterious contact proves to be Gregor Eisenhorn, aided by Cherubael. Eisenhorn warns that the Fratery has foreseen a terrible daemon manifesting in connection with Ravenor's Eustis Majoris investigation.

books.title: Ravenor Returned
books.summary: Working covertly on Eustis Majoris, Ravenor's team uncovers a Secretist conspiracy using tainted cogitators to reconstruct Enuncia, while Marshal Maud Plyton is hunted for what she found. Culzean's Brass Thief kills Mathuin, and Carl Thonius, a flect user, is secretly possessed by the daemon Slyte. Slyte's intervention wrecks the Enuncia ritual and much of Petropolis, and the Diadochoi is revealed as Zygmunt Molotch, who escapes.

books.title: Ravenor Rogue
books.summary: Ordered off the hunt for Molotch, Ravenor goes rogue after Molotch massacres Inquisitor Fenx's team. A trap at the Wych House of Utochre scatters his band across space and time through a tri-portal, and the trail leads to Culzean's bolthole on Gudrun. Zael reveals Thonius as Slyte's host; the daemon manifests, Ravenor and Molotch banish it through the door, and Ravenor kills Molotch before surrendering to the Inquisition.

books.title: Pariah
books.summary: In Queen Mab on Sancour, the blank Beta Bequin is nearly a graduate of the Maze Undue when a raid destroys the school and scatters her into hiding. Pursued by the Blackwards house, the Ministorum and its Word Bearer allies, the Emperor's Children sorcerer Teke and the grael-host Judika, she is helped by the Curst Renner Lightburn and the mysterious Deathrow. Eisenhorn's people reveal that the Maze was a Cognitae front, that the raid was Ravenor's, and that she is a clone of Alizebeth Bequin. A trap delivers her to Ravenor, and Cherubael snatches her from his cell at Eisenhorn's order.

books.title: Penitent
books.summary: Months later, Beta works with Eisenhorn to find a way into the King in Yellow's City of Dust, chasing the blind astronomer Freddy Dance to decode Lilean Chase's ciphered book. She recovers the mind-wiped Lightburn and gains the winged Blood Angel Comus. Eisenhorn apparently dies when his base burns, so she joins Ravenor, uncovers the King's purge of the Cognitae and witnesses the Immaterial College fight hundreds of graels. Ravenor's Aeldari contacts give Sancour one week before five craftworlds strike, and Eisenhorn turns out to be alive. Beta enters the City of Dust through a mirror and escapes, and Dance decodes the King's name: Constantin Valdor.

Suspected of being Slyte's vessel, he spends Ravenor Rogue in a self-induced coma, secretly reaching out through Frauka, and finally exposes Thonius as the daemon's host.

characters.name: Zygmunt Molotch
characters.title: Cognitae arch-heretic
characters.fate: After allying with Ravenor to banish Slyte, he tries to flee and Ravenor destroys his mind in a field on Gudrun.
characters.summary: A Cognitae-trained genius and Ravenor's nemesis for decades, apparently killed in the first novel's prologue. Hideously scarred, he secretly rules the sub-sector as Lord Governor Barazan, the Diadochoi, driving the Enuncia conspiracy and using the language to restore his body. Not a psyker, he uses a "tone of command", lethal martial skill and occult knowledge.

characters.epithet: Moriarty to an Inquisitor's Holmes

characters.name: Angharad Esw Sweydyr
characters.title: Carthaen swordswoman
characters.fate: Devoured by Slyte on Gudrun when she stands to fight the manifested daemon.
characters.summary: Niece of Arianhrod, Ravenor's lost love, and her near double. A member of Inquisitor Fenx's retinue, she survives Molotch's massacre only because she was late from a tryst with Nayl, rescues Ballack, and joins Ravenor. Her affair with Nayl wounds Ravenor deeply.

arcs.ravenor: Niece of Arianhrod, Ravenor's lost love, and her near double. A member of Inquisitor Fenx's retinue, she survives Molotch's massacre only because she was late from a tryst with Nayl, rescues Ballack, and joins Ravenor. Her affair with Nayl wounds Ravenor deeply.

characters.epithet: Evisorex thirsts, and so does she

relationships.note: cuts off his hand to save him

characters.name: Commodus Voke
characters.title: Inquisitor, Ordo Malleus
characters.fate: Killed in psychic combat with the daemonhost Prophaniti on Farness Beta; buried with full honours on Thracian Primaris.
characters.summary: An ancient, caustic, powerfully psychic Thorian inquisitor. As a young novice he helped hunt down Pontius Glaw two centuries earlier. He investigates House Glaw alongside Eisenhorn, runs the auto-seance on Malahite with him, and later joins his cell against Quixos.

characters.epithet: An old flame burning out

characters.name: Comus Nocturnus
characters.title: Winged Blood Angel
characters.fate: Last seen fighting Cherubael at Beta's command.
characters.origin: City of Dust (escaped via the Below)
characters.summary: An amnesiac Blood Angel with real wings like Sanguinius, apparently a creation of the King in Yellow. He bursts out of the Below in the grip of the Red Thirst, which Beta's aura calms. He swears to her and comes whenever her blood is spilled. Unarmoured and naked, he kills an armoured Night Lord barehanded.

characters.epithet: An angel answering to blood

characters.name: Deathrow
characters.title: Holloway watchman, secretly Alpha Legion
characters.fate: Defeats Teke while protecting Beta and reveals 'I am Alpharius'. His later role is unrevealed.
characters.summary: A masked, gene-altered veteran who patrols Queen Mab's holloways with his hound. He has secretly watched over Beta for years. He is one of Eisenhorn's specialists and an Alpha Legionnaire: he runs Teke through, and Teke glimpses the truth behind his mask.

characters.epithet: The watchman with a Legion's secret

characters.name: Fayde Thuring
characters.title: Heretic
characters.fate: Dies when Cherubael destroys the Chaos Titan Cruor Vult he has awakened on Durer.
characters.summary: A survivor of the Hearthood cult who killed Midas Betancore in 312.M41 and evaded Eisenhorn for decades. On Durer's island of Miquol he awakens the Warlord Titan Cruor Vult, and the cost of defeating it is terrible.

characters.epithet: Eighty years of debt, paid in fire

characters.name: Freddy Dance
characters.title: Mad astronomer and mathematician
characters.fate: Decodes Lilean Chase's book under Lightburn's guard, revealing 'Constantin Valdor'.
characters.summary: A disgraced, blind astronomer whose star charts match no sky over Queen Mab, because he had seen the stars of the City of Dust. Eisenhorn and Beta seek him as a way in. Beta realises he is not truly mad. He theorises about Enuncia as numbers and suspects the King is a Lost Primarch.

characters.epithet: He read the wrong sky

characters.name: Geard Bure
characters.title: Magos, Adeptus Mechanicus
characters.fate: Some years after Malleus, Pontius Glaw kills him using the mechanical body Bure built, then escapes Cinchare.
characters.summary: An ancient tech-priest and former Titan forge architect who keeps the Pontius casket for Eisenhorn on Cinchare. In Malleus he destroys the Chaos-tainted geode called the Lith, forges Eisenhorn's runestaff and reworks Barbarisater. At Eisenhorn's request he builds Glaw a body, which proves fatal.

characters.epithet: The smith who built his own killer

characters.name: Golesh Heldane
characters.title: Interrogator, later Inquisitor (Ordo Malleus)
characters.fate: Survives the boarding of the Essene, nearly killed by Cherubael, and keeps silent about how Osma died.
characters.summary: Voke's pupil, horribly mauled by a carnodon in the Glaw arena and later surgically exaggerating the scars into an equine face. As an inquisitor his psychic power surpasses Voke's. With Osma he springs the trap at Jeganda to capture Eisenhorn and seize Cherubael and the Codicium.

characters.epithet: Scarred zealot with a long memory

characters.name: Gorgone Locke
characters.title: Shipmaster of House Glaw
characters.fate: Crushed by a falling column on 56-Izar; Eisenhorn carves the mark of heresy on his brow as he dies.
characters.summary: A red-haired giant of a shipmaster who serves House Glaw as a torturer. His neural scourge leaves Eisenhorn's face permanently unable to smile. He flees with the cabal to trade for the Necroteuch.

arcs.eisenhorn: A red-haired giant of a shipmaster who serves House Glaw as a torturer. His neural scourge leaves Eisenhorn's face permanently unable to smile. He flees with the cabal to trade for the Necroteuch.

characters.epithet: The man who stole a smile

characters.name: Jader Trice
characters.title: Grand Provost, Ministry of Sub-Sector Trade
characters.fate: Withered to dust by Slyte as his Enuncia lexicon is torn apart.
characters.summary: A former Cognitae who spent twenty years building the scheme to reconstruct Enuncia through tainted cogitators, only to have the Diadochoi take it over. Respected and well-groomed, he steers Ravenor towards the Mergent trap in the first book and leads the Secretists in the second.

characters.epithet: A bureaucrat building a god's grammar

characters.name: Judika Sowl
characters.title: Maze Undue graduate and grael host
characters.fate: Killed by Teke, who recognised him as one of the Eight. A seeming clone of him later confronts Beta in the City of Dust.
characters.summary: A blank who graduated from the Maze a few years ahead of Beta and was said to have become an interrogator. Beta once had a crush on him. He flees the raid with her but is snide, and his health fails. He had ingested an 'Eight' and was host to the grael Magent, which attacked the cathedral during Beta's Enuncia ordeal.

characters.epithet: The boy with a spider inside

relationships.note: host of one of the Eight

characters.name: Konrad Molitor
characters.title: Radical Inquisitor
characters.fate: Killed by Eisenhorn (with Bequin's help) on 56-Izar while trying to seize the Necroteuch.
characters.summary: A flamboyant radical inquisitor in yellow-and-black who flays the captive Malahite to death before Eisenhorn can question him. On 56-Izar he tries to take the Necroteuch for study and calls down a bombardment. He is secretly acting for Quixos, and one of his henchmen is Cherubael in disguise.

characters.epithet: Quixos's smiling cat's-paw

characters.name: Leonid Osma
characters.title: Inquisitor, Ordo Malleus; later Grandmaster
characters.fate: Shot in the back of the head by Tobias Maxilla aboard the Essene just before he can kill Eisenhorn.
characters.summary: A pugnacious Ordo Malleus inquisitor with a bionic jaw who arrests Eisenhorn on Cadia, declares him Extremis Diabolus and has him imprisoned in the Carnificina. Risen to Grandmaster by Hereticus, he uses Fischig to trap Eisenhorn, apparently wanting Cherubael and the Codicium for himself.

characters.epithet: A hammer seeking the wrong anvil

characters.name: Lucius Worna
characters.title: Bounty hunter
characters.fate: After surviving grenades and kineblades, Kys holds him out into a storm where lightning strikes him repeatedly.
characters.summary: A colossal, scar-faced bounty hunter in mother-of-pearl power armour and an old associate of Nayl, possibly a renegade Space Marine. Glimpsed briefly in the first book, he is hired to hunt Ravenor and returns as the villains' muscle, almost impossible to kill.

arcs.ravenor: A colossal, scar-faced bounty hunter in mother-of-pearl power armour and an old associate of Nayl, possibly a renegade Space Marine. Glimpsed briefly in the first book, he is hired to hunt Ravenor and returns as the villains' muscle, almost impossible to kill.

characters.epithet: End of story, eventually

characters.name: Mam Mordaunt
characters.title: Senior Cognitae mentor of the Maze Undue
characters.fate: Called on the Immaterial College when hundreds of graels attacked her hideout, then vanished in the chaos.
characters.summary: In Pariah she is mostly off-stage: Patience Kys impersonates her to lure Beta. In Penitent she is one of the last Cognitae leaders. The King in Yellow has turned on the Cognitae, and she hides in a tower full of spying 'secret mirrors', seeking protection from Eisenhorn and then the Immaterial College.

characters.wargear: Secret mirrors; weapons usable against graels
characters.epithet: Last mistress of a betrayed school

characters.name: Mandragore Carrion
characters.title: Emperor's Children Chaos Space Marine
characters.fate: Tricked into grasping the Necroteuch, he is paralysed and beheaded by Eisenhorn on KCX-1288.
characters.summary: A Traitor Astartes champion of Slaanesh who helps House Glaw's hunt for the Necroteuch, first met overseeing the excavation on Damask.

arcs.eisenhorn: A Traitor Astartes champion of Slaanesh who helps House Glaw's hunt for the Necroteuch, first met overseeing the excavation on Damask.

characters.epithet: A Slaaneshi giant felled by a book

characters.name: Maud Plyton
characters.title: Ex-Magistratum marshal
characters.fate: One of only two people still at Ravenor's side at the end, bringing him news of the Listening Post surgeon.
characters.summary: A junior marshal of Petropolis Magistratum Special Crimes who briefly arrests Kara in the first book. Investigating an archdeacon's death and a hidden ceiling mural, she becomes the sole survivor when the conspirators purge her department, and joins Ravenor. Thonius later toys with her mind.

arcs.ravenor: A junior marshal of Petropolis Magistratum Special Crimes who briefly arrests Kara in the first book. characters.epithet: The last honest cop in Petropolis

relationships.note: her mind is manipulated by him

characters.name: Orfeo Culzean
characters.title: Expeditor and antiquarian
characters.fate: Betrays Ravenor and Molotch to bind Slyte, is gut-shot, and is rotted alive by the daemon.
characters.summary: A suave, cultured antiquities dealer who hires himself out as a facilitator to heretical cults, first to the Divine Fratery to bring about Slyte. He collects deodands, objects that caused accidental deaths, and commands the Brass Thief. In Ravenor Rogue he partners with Molotch, but his attempt to harness Slyte proves fatal.

characters.epithet: A gentleman who brokers apocalypses

relationships.note: seeks to bind it, is killed

characters.name: Patrik Belknap
characters.title: Medicae
characters.fate: Leaves Kara and Ravenor's service after learning she hid Slyte's existence.
characters.summary: A former Imperial Guard field medic turned unlicensed back-street medicae in Petropolis who once looked out for Zael. He treats Kara's vampiric-blade wound, discovers her cancer, and falls in love with her. A devout man, he joins the team but walks away when Kara's secret is exposed.

characters.epithet: A healer whose faith would not bend

characters.name: Sholto Unwerth
characters.title: Captain of the Arethusa
characters.fate: Survives and returns to trading, breaking contact with Ravenor.
characters.summary: A tiny, eccentric trader captain, rumoured to have Squat ancestry, who mangles Low Gothic magnificently. First met at Bonner's Reach, he ferries Ravenor's team from then on. Tortured by Siskind and Worna in Ravenor Returned, losing four fingers, he remains unwaveringly loyal and is a brilliant pilot.

characters.wargear: His ship Arethusa; his manhound servant Fyflank
characters.epithet: Small captain, big words, bigger heart

characters.name: Teke
characters.title: Emperor's Children sorcerer
characters.fate: Run through by Deathrow and forced into an undignified retreat; later fate unknown.
characters.summary: A cultured Chaos Space Marine of the Emperor's Children, sent (reportedly at Fulgrim's command) to find the way into the City of Dust. He kills Judika, savages Scarpac's Word Bearers and attacks Beta and Lightburn. He wields sorcerous rose petals that swarm or form armour.

characters.wargear: Sorcerous rose petals forming a swarm or power armour
characters.epithet: Petals, poison and a permanent grin

characters.name: Titus Endor
characters.title: Inquisitor, Ordo Xenos then Ordo Malleus
characters.fate: Badly wounded on Farness Beta and estranged from Eisenhorn; he later dies of cerebral worms caught from Hapshant (told outside the omnibus).
characters.summary: Eisenhorn's fellow interrogator under Hapshant and his only real friend in the Inquisition. In Xenos he chases Gorgone Locke on 56-Izar. Pressured into the Ordo Malleus, he agrees to spy on Eisenhorn, and on Farness Beta it emerges that he meant to arrest him after the battle, which ends their friendship.

characters.name: Tobias Maxilla
characters.title: Rogue Trader, master of the Essene
characters.fate: Mortally wounded when Osma's forces board the Essene, he uses his last strength to shoot Osma dead and save Eisenhorn.
characters.summary: An extravagantly dressed rogue trader, raised by the trader Vaden Awl, whose ship the Essene carries Eisenhorn through all three novels. When an assassination attempt on Eisenhorn injures him, it reveals that much of his lower body is mechanical. He helps spring Eisenhorn from the Carnificina.

characters.wargear: The starship Essene, digital ring weapon
characters.epithet: A dandy who died a hero

characters.name: Wystan Frauka
characters.title: Blank (untouchable)
characters.fate: His blankness burned away by Zael, he is handed over to the Inquisition's black ships for testing.
characters.summary: A chain-smoking, porn-reading untouchable whose limiter lets him switch his null aura on and off. He saves Ravenor by killing the psyker Kinsky in the first novel. Assigned to guard the comatose Zael in Ravenor Rogue, he is gradually psychically "touched" by the boy and helps reveal that Thonius is Slyte.

characters.wargear: Pariah limiter implant, lho-sticks, trashy data-slates
characters.epithet: The soulless man who found a soul

characters.name: Zeph Mathuin
characters.title: Agent, ex-bounty hunter
characters.fate: Killed by Culzean's Brass Thief while defending Ravenor's Petropolis hideout.
characters.summary: A taciturn, dreadlocked former bounty hunter with red augmetic eyes and an augmetic arm that interfaces with his rotator cannon. Ravenor often wares him when he needs to appear in person. He is the first of the retinue to die during the trilogy.

arcs.ravenor: A taciturn, dreadlocked former bounty hunter with red augmetic eyes and an augmetic arm that interfaces with his rotator cannon. Ravenor often wares him when he needs to appear in person. He is the first of the retinue to die during the trilogy.

characters.wargear: Six-barrelled rotator cannon with support frame; augmetic arm and eyes
characters.epithet: The gun Ravenor wore like a body

characters.name: Alace Quatorze
characters.title: Last scion of House Glaw
characters.fate: Her pact with the Emperor's Children collapsed when she failed to open the way to the City of Dust.
characters.summary: Mistress of the Villa Feverfugue and patron of Shadrake. She is secretly a Glaw, of the heretic dynasty Eisenhorn fought, and is seeking the entrance to the City of Dust for her ally Teke. She hands Beta and Judika over to him.

arcs.bequin: Mistress of the Villa Feverfugue and patron of Shadrake. She is secretly a Glaw, of the heretic dynasty Eisenhorn fought, and is seeking the entrance to the City of Dust for her ally Teke. She hands Beta and Judika over to him.

characters.epithet: An old heresy's last daughter

characters.name: Arianhrod Esw Sweydyr
characters.title: Carthaen swordswoman
characters.fate: Killed on Lethe Eleven by a Dark Eldar haemonculus during the raid on Beldame Sadia.
characters.summary: A swordswoman of the Esw Sweydyr tribe of Carthae, and Gideon Ravenor's lover. She carried Barbarisater, a semi-sentient blade that her tribe had held for nineteen generations. After her death the sword passes to Eisenhorn, and Magos Bure reworks it into his force sword.

characters.epithet: Her blade outlived her

characters.name: Arnault Tantalid
characters.title: Witchfinder, Ordo Hereticus
characters.fate: Killed by Eisenhorn on Orbul Infanta after killing the astropath Ungish.
characters.summary: A witch hunter who comes to Lethe Eleven to arrest Eisenhorn for heresy. He ends up saving his life by killing Beldame Sadia. Medea drives him off, and he later ambushes the outlawed Eisenhorn on Orbul Infanta.

arcs.eisenhorn: A witch hunter who comes to Lethe Eleven to arrest Eisenhorn for heresy. He ends up saving his life by killing Beldame Sadia. Medea drives him off, and he later ambushes the outlawed Eisenhorn on Orbul Infanta.

characters.epithet: Zeal without discernment

characters.name: Balthus Blackwards
characters.title: Patriarch of the Blackwards merchant house
characters.fate: His deal with the Ministorum and the Word Bearers collapsed with the cathedral, ruining his house's gamble.
characters.summary: Head of the Blackwards dynasty, which deals in heretical artefacts for the Glaws, the Cognitae and even the King in Yellow. Beta was investigating his emporium undercover. After the Maze fell he abducted her and sold her to the Ecclesiarchy's Enuncia project.

characters.wargear: Animated, poison-bladed dolls of the Blackwards Emporium
characters.epithet: A merchant who sold the wrong girl

characters.name: Bartol Siskind
characters.title: Would-be cartel member
characters.fate: Hires Worna to hunt Ravenor; his ultimate fate is not confirmed in the sources consulted.
characters.summary: A distant relative of Thekla with a Cognitae bloodline who wanted into Contract Thirteen but lacked the funds. Questioned by Ravenor in the first book, he survives to hire Lucius Worna to hunt Ravenor, and tortures Sholto Unwerth.

characters.epithet: A small heretic with a long grudge

characters.name: Bastian Verveuk

characters.fate: Dying after the fight with Cruor Vult, he is made the host body for Cherubael by Eisenhorn.
characters.summary: A young, naive puritan inquisitor sent to shadow Eisenhorn at the Durer Court of Examination, to Eisenhorn's irritation. He insists on joining the hunt for Fayde Thuring. Using him as a host is one of Eisenhorn's darkest acts.

characters.epithet: An idealist spent as a vessel

characters.name: Beldame Sadia
characters.title: Xenophile cult leader
characters.fate: Killed by the witchfinder Tantalid on Lethe Eleven as she tries to murder the poisoned Eisenhorn.
characters.summary: A centuries-old xenophile who struck compacts with the Dark Eldar. She recruits only convicted murderers and moves on an eight-legged spider carriage, with venom sacs in her cheeks. Eisenhorn's raid on her cult opens Malleus.

arcs.eisenhorn: A centuries-old xenophile who struck compacts with the Dark Eldar. She recruits only convicted murderers and moves on an eight-legged spider carriage, with venom sacs in her cheeks. Eisenhorn's raid on her cult opens Malleus.

characters.wargear: Spider-legged carriage, venom sacs, augmetic fangs
characters.epithet: A spider in a ruined church

characters.name: Connort Timurlin
characters.title: Cognitae perfecti assassin
characters.fate: Killed attacking Beta's group. Ravenor's séance with his spirit accidentally summoned the Immaterial College.
characters.summary: One of the few remaining Cognitae perfecti, bodyguard to Mam Mordaunt. He was sent to negotiate with Eisenhorn and keeps a 'blinkblade' in a pocket dimension. Interrogated after death, he reveals the King's purge of the Cognitae.

arcs.bequin: One of the few remaining Cognitae perfecti, bodyguard to Mam Mordaunt. He was sent to negotiate with Eisenhorn and keeps a 'blinkblade' in a pocket dimension. Interrogated after death, he reveals the King's purge of the Cognitae.

characters.epithet: A blade in the blink of an eye

characters.name: Constant Shadrake
characters.title: Warp-touched painter
characters.fate: Killed during the confrontation at Alace Quatorze's villa.
characters.summary: A painter who works through a viewing glass that shows reality shaped by the Immaterium. Beta once investigated him while posing as the model Padua Prate. After the cathedral he shelters her and takes her to his patron, Alace Quatorze, who had been using him.

arcs.bequin: A painter who works through a viewing glass that shows reality shaped by the Immaterium. Beta once investigated him while posing as the model Padua Prate. After the cathedral he shelters her and takes her to his patron, Alace Quatorze, who had been using him.

characters.epithet: He painted what the glass saw

characters.name: Crezia Berschilde
characters.title: Surgeon of Ravello
characters.fate: Survives and later becomes Chief Medicae at the Universitariate of New Gevae.
characters.summary: A surgeon and Eisenhorn's former lover, first met when she treated him after he lost his hand. She shelters the fugitive team in Ravello, treats the wounded Medea, and flees with them to New Gevae.

arcs.eisenhorn: A surgeon and Eisenhorn's former lover, first met when she treated him after he lost his hand. She shelters the fugitive team in Ravello, treats the wounded Medea, and flees with them to New Gevae.

characters.epithet: A healer who opened her door

characters.name: Cynia Preest
characters.title: Shipmistress of the Hinterlight
characters.fate: Survives and breaks off contact with Ravenor.
characters.summary: The centuries-old mistress of the Hinterlight, the stealth-equipped rogue trader ship Ravenor regularly employs. Captured during the Bonner's Reach betrayal, she is freed by Kara and helps retake her ship. She returns with the Hinterlight to pick up Ravenor in Ravenor Rogue.

arcs.ravenor: The centuries-old mistress of the Hinterlight, the stealth-equipped rogue trader ship Ravenor regularly employs. Captured during the Bonner's Reach betrayal, she is freed by Kara and helps retake her ship. She returns with the Hinterlight to pick up Ravenor in Ravenor Rogue.

characters.wargear: The Hinterlight with its xenos-derived stealth system
characters.epithet: Mistress of a ship that hides

characters.name: Darra Voriet
characters.title: Interrogator, Ordo Hereticus
characters.fate: Killed infiltrating the Maze Undue after weapons-master Saur, rescued by Beta, overcame him. His death prompted Ravenor's raid.
characters.summary: An Inquisition operative earlier attached to Eisenhorn, who suspected he was a plant. In Pariah he is Ravenor's agent. He breaks into the Maze Undue and dies naming the Cognitae, the first hint of the school's true masters.

arcs.bequin: An Inquisition operative earlier attached to Eisenhorn, who suspected he was a plant. In Pariah he is Ravenor's agent. He breaks into the Maze Undue and dies naming the Cognitae, the first hint of the school's true masters.

characters.epithet: The spy whose death lit the fuse

relationships.note: spied on him for the Inquisition

characters.name: Esarhaddon
characters.title: Alpha-plus rogue psyker
characters.fate: Taken by Cherubael to Quixos on Farness Beta; whether he survives the assault is not clearly recorded.
characters.summary: The most powerful of the alpha-plus psykers paraded at the Thracian Primaris Triumph, and the real prize of the Atrocity. A decoy dies in his place, and he is auctioned on Eechan before Cherubael carries him off.

arcs.eisenhorn: The most powerful of the alpha-plus psykers paraded at the Thracian Primaris Triumph, and the real prize of the Atrocity. A decoy dies in his place, and he is auctioned on Eechan before Cherubael carries him off.

characters.epithet: The prize behind the massacre

characters.name: Feaver Skoh
characters.title: Xenos hunter
characters.fate: Knocked unconscious by Ravenor and interrogated, revealing Contract Thirteen.
characters.summary: A xenos hunter working with rogue trader Kizary Thekla, blamed by Trice for the flect smuggling. He springs the trap on Ravenor at Bonner's Reach and boards the Hinterlight to hunt Kys.

arcs.ravenor: A xenos hunter working with rogue trader Kizary Thekla, blamed by Trice for the flect smuggling. He springs the trap on Ravenor at Bonner's Reach and boards the Hinterlight to hunt Kys.

characters.epithet: A hunter who boarded the wrong ship

characters.name: Gall Ballack
characters.title: Interrogator, Cognitae mole
characters.fate: Captured infiltrating Culzean's Gudrun stronghold and shot by Molotch while blurting the Cognitae code-greeting.
characters.summary: White-haired interrogator to Inquisitor Fenx, secretly a third- or fourth-generation Cognitae who sold his master out to Molotch, only to be left for dead. He loses a hand escaping and joins Ravenor seeking revenge, hiding his true allegiance. Ravenor briefly suspects him of being Slyte.

arcs.ravenor: White-haired interrogator to Inquisitor Fenx, secretly a third- or fourth-generation Cognitae who sold his master out to Molotch, only to be left for dead. He loses a hand escaping and joins Ravenor seeking revenge, hiding his true allegiance. Ravenor briefly suspects him of being Slyte.

characters.wargear: Augmetic hand with hidden single-shot laspistol
characters.epithet: A mole left to rot by his master

characters.name: Girolamo Malahite
characters.title: Archaeoxenologist
characters.fate: Dies under Molitor's interrogation; even dead, his mind summons a daemon during the auto-seance.
characters.summary: House Glaw's expert on the saruthi, captured by Eisenhorn on KCX-1288. Through an auto-seance on his corpse, Eisenhorn and Voke learn that the saruthi hold their own copy of the Necroteuch.

arcs.eisenhorn: House Glaw's expert on the saruthi, captured by Eisenhorn on KCX-1288. Through an auto-seance on his corpse, Eisenhorn and Voke learn that the saruthi hold their own copy of the Necroteuch.

characters.epithet: Secrets wrung from a corpse

characters.name: Iosob
characters.title: Wych House housekeeper
characters.fate: Taken away by the Inquisition for testing along with Zael and Frauka.
characters.summary: A young girl, barely adolescent, who serves as a keyholder of the Wych House of Utochre and its tri-portal door. When the House is destroyed she flees with Ravenor through the door, using her key to carry them across space and time.

arcs.ravenor: A young girl, barely adolescent, who serves as a keyholder of the Wych House of Utochre and its tri-portal door. When the House is destroyed she flees with Ravenor through the door, using her key to carry them across space and time.

characters.epithet: The child who holds the door's key

characters.name: Kizary Thekla
characters.title: Rogue trader, Oktober Country
characters.fate: Killed when Ravenor forces down his shields and missiles strike the Oktober Country's bridge.
characters.summary: A rogue trader of the Contract Thirteen cartel whose grandparents were tied to the Cognitae. Captaining the Oktober Country, he fires on the Hinterlight to kill Ravenor even at the cost of his allies.

arcs.ravenor: A rogue trader of the Contract Thirteen cartel whose grandparents were tied to the Cognitae. Captaining the Oktober Country, he fires on the Hinterlight to kill Ravenor even at the cost of his allies.

characters.epithet: Profit at any cost, even his own

characters.name: Leyla Slade
characters.title: Culzean's bodyguard
characters.fate: Last seen standing against the manifested Slyte to buy Culzean time to escape.
characters.summary: Orfeo Culzean's fiercely loyal right hand and bodyguard, disdainful of Molotch and his schemes. A formidable fighter who battles Thonius to a standstill, she carries pistol rounds that summon daemons.

arcs.ravenor: Orfeo Culzean's fiercely loyal right hand and bodyguard, disdainful of Molotch and his schemes. A formidable fighter who battles Thonius to a standstill, she carries pistol rounds that summon daemons.

characters.epithet: Loyalty loaded with daemons

characters.name: Lilean Chase
characters.title: Founder of the Cognitae
characters.fate: Long dead; her ciphered commonplace book yields the King in Yellow's name.
characters.summary: The ancient founder of the Cognitae, present only through her writings. Beta obtains one of her journals in Pariah, encoded and showing only the number 119. Freddy Dance decodes it in Penitent.

arcs.bequin: The ancient founder of the Cognitae, present only through her writings. Beta obtains one of her journals in Pariah, encoded and showing only the number 119. Freddy Dance decodes it in Penitent.

characters.epithet: A dead woman's cipher names a king

characters.name: Lomer Kinsky
characters.title: Ministry psyker
characters.fate: Frauka snaps his neck aboard the Hinterlight.
characters.summary: A raw, enormously powerful psyker assigned by the Ministry of Sub-Sector Trade to assist Ravenor, who in truth helps lure him into a trap. He defeats Ravenor in their first psychic clash and nearly kills him in the second.

arcs.ravenor: A raw, enormously powerful psyker assigned by the Ministry of Sub-Sector Trade to assist Ravenor, who in truth helps lure him into a trap. He defeats Ravenor in their first psychic clash and nearly kills him in the second.

characters.epithet: Brute strength of the mind

characters.name: Lores Vibben
characters.title: Bodyguard
characters.fate: Killed on Hubris by Murdin Eyclone; Eisenhorn executes Eyclone with her pistol and buries it with her.
characters.summary: An ex-ganger who served as Eisenhorn's bodyguard and aide. She marked his stub pistol with her gang's skull-and-rose colours, which he later understood as an honour. Her death in the first chapter of Xenos sets the tone of the trilogy.

arcs.eisenhorn: An ex-ganger who served as Eisenhorn's bodyguard and aide. She marked his stub pistol with her gang's skull-and-rose colours, which he later understood as an honour. Her death in the first chapter of Xenos sets the tone of the trilogy.

characters.wargear: Gang-marked Scipio stub pistol (given to Eisenhorn)
characters.epithet: Her pistol delivered the final verdict

characters.name: Lyko
characters.title: Inquisitor (traitor)
characters.fate: Cornered on Eechan, his brain is burned out by Cherubael before Eisenhorn can read his mind.
characters.summary: An inquisitor who helped capture the 33 psykers in the Helican Crusade. During the Thracian Atrocity he appears to incinerate the escaped psyker Esarhaddon, but the victim was someone else. Eisenhorn trails him to an auction on Eechan, where his collusion with Cherubael is exposed.

arcs.eisenhorn: An inquisitor who helped capture the 33 psykers in the Helican Crusade. During the Thracian Atrocity he appears to incinerate the escaped psyker Esarhaddon, but the victim was someone else. Eisenhorn trails him to an auction on Eechan, where his collusion with Cherubael is exposed.

characters.epithet: The inquisitor who sold the triumph

characters.name: Madsen
characters.title: Ministry tech-adept
characters.fate: Kys slits her throat with telekinetically flung scales.
characters.summary: The tech-adept leader of the Ministry trio sent with Ravenor, and architect of the plan to seize the Hinterlight and send it into Bonner's Reach's star.

arcs.ravenor: The tech-adept leader of the Ministry trio sent with Ravenor, and architect of the plan to seize the Hinterlight and send it into Bonner's Reach's star.

characters.epithet: The quiet hand on the tiller

characters.name: Marla Tarray
characters.title: Mercenary paymaster
characters.fate: Annihilated in New Gevae by a warp vortex Eisenhorn unleashes through a reanimated thrall.
characters.summary: The woman who hires the Vessorine Janissaries and other mercenaries on behalf of "Khanjar the Sharp" for the coordinated strikes on Eisenhorn. She is revealed to be the daughter of Pontius Glaw.

arcs.eisenhorn: The woman who hires the Vessorine Janissaries and other mercenaries on behalf of "Khanjar the Sharp" for the coordinated strikes on Eisenhorn. She is revealed to be the daughter of Pontius Glaw.

characters.epithet: Glaw's daughter, the hand behind the knives

characters.name: Murdin Eyclone
characters.title: Chaos "facilitator"
characters.fate: Shot dead by Eisenhorn on Hubris with Lores Vibben's pistol.
characters.summary: A psyker-for-hire to Chaos cults who can control minds and wipe memories. After a six-year hunt Eisenhorn corners him on Hubris, where he murders thousands of cryo-sleepers in a ritual meant to aid Pontius Glaw.

arcs.eisenhorn: A psyker-for-hire to Chaos cults who can control minds and wipe memories. After a six-year hunt Eisenhorn corners him on Hubris, where he murders thousands of cryo-sleepers in a ritual meant to aid Pontius Glaw.

characters.wargear: Extending metallic worm hidden under a fingernail
characters.epithet: The murderer who opened the case

relationships.note: hunted by him for six years

characters.name: Nathun Inshabel
characters.title: Interrogator
characters.fate: Murdered with his entire staff in Pontius Glaw's simultaneous strikes on Eisenhorn's network.
characters.summary: An interrogator who works with Eisenhorn during the Quixos affair. He discovers that the psyker Lyko 'killed' on Thracian Primaris was not really Esarhaddon, and he is with Eisenhorn on Cinchare when Eisenhorn bargains with Glaw.

arcs.eisenhorn: An interrogator who works with Eisenhorn during the Quixos affair. He discovers that the psyker Lyko 'killed' on Thracian Primaris was not really Esarhaddon, and he is with Eisenhorn on Cinchare when Eisenhorn bargains with Glaw.

characters.epithet: A loyal blade cut down off-stage

characters.name: Neve
characters.title: Inquisitor General, Cadia
characters.fate: Gravely wounded by Prophaniti at the Cadian pylon; later sends Raum Grumman as her proxy.
characters.summary: A stern puritan Inquisitor General on Cadia who distrusts roving inquisitors. Eisenhorn wins her over, and together they trace the Sons of Bael cult to Quixos. She opens the Cadian archives at Kasr Derth to him.

arcs.eisenhorn: A stern puritan Inquisitor General on Cadia who distrusts roving inquisitors. Eisenhorn wins her over, and together they trace the Sons of Bael cult to Quixos. She opens the Cadian archives at Kasr Derth to him.

characters.epithet: Guardian of the Gate, slow to trust

characters.name: Oberon Glaw
characters.title: Lord of House Glaw
characters.fate: Killed on KCX-1288 when shrapnel from an explosion impales him during the Necroteuch exchange.
characters.summary: The head of House Glaw in 240.M41, secretly devoted to Slaanesh. He leads the family's plot to obtain the Necroteuch from the saruthi and escapes Voke's purge of the Glaw estate aboard Captain Estrum's renegade ships.

arcs.eisenhorn: The head of House Glaw in 240.M41, secretly devoted to Slaanesh. He leads the family's plot to obtain the Necroteuch from the saruthi and escapes Voke's purge of the Glaw estate aboard Captain Estrum's renegade ships.

characters.epithet: Old blood, rotten to the core

characters.name: Phlebas Alessandro Rorken
characters.title: Lord Inquisitor, Ordo Xenos Helican
characters.fate: Outlives the Eisenhorn trilogy to become Grandmaster of the Ordos Helican, and is still Ravenor's superior when Ravenor surrenders himself for judgement at the end of Ravenor Rogue.
characters.summary: Eisenhorn's superior, a stern puritan Lord Inquisitor in crimson robes. He leads the task force against 56-Izar and later quietly helps Eisenhorn when he is outlawed, sending Massimo Ricci to join the hunt for Quixos.

arcs.eisenhorn: Eisenhorn's superior, a stern puritan Lord Inquisitor in crimson robes. He leads the task force against 56-Izar and later quietly helps Eisenhorn when he is outlawed, sending Massimo Ricci to join the hunt for Quixos.
arcs.ravenor: Ravenor's superior and an old friend of Eisenhorn. Ravenor addresses his report in Ravenor Returned to him, and a recorded message from Rorken orders him off Molotch's trail in Ravenor Rogue. He appears largely off-page.

characters.epithet: The steady hand above the storm

characters.name: Prophaniti
characters.title: Daemonhost
characters.fate: Destroyed by Eisenhorn's runestaff on Farness Beta, apparently suffering a true death.
characters.summary: Quixos's second daemonhost, a daemon whose true name Quixos never learned. It battles Eisenhorn and Neve at a Cadian pylon and survives the loss of its host by possessing Husmaan. On Farness Beta it kills Commodus Voke.

arcs.eisenhorn: Quixos's second daemonhost, a daemon whose true name Quixos never learned. It battles Eisenhorn and Neve at a Cadian pylon and survives the loss of its host by possessing Husmaan. On Farness Beta it kills Commodus Voke.

characters.epithet: A nameless profanity given flesh

characters.name: Sadoth Xarbia
characters.title: Night Lord of the Immaterial College
characters.fate: Pursued Beta and was stopped by her grael-weapons and Comus. The TV Tropes page says Comus killed a Night Lord barehanded.
characters.summary: A Night Lords sorcerer with psychic bat-wings who fights with lightning claws and bolter. Most of what is known of the College comes from his boasting, which earns a blow from a fellow member. He chases Beta after the grael battle.

arcs.bequin: A Night Lords sorcerer with psychic bat-wings who fights with lightning claws and bolter. Most of what is known of the College comes from his boasting, which earns a blow from a fellow member. He chases Beta after the grael battle.

characters.epithet: A night-winged braggart

characters.name: Scarpac
characters.title: Word Bearers champion
characters.fate: Pursuing Beta, he clashed with Teke and was apparently destroyed.
characters.summary: Leader of the Word Bearers allied with Queen Mab's Ministorum and the Blackwards. He sought a pariah to speak Enuncia against the King in Yellow, and forced Beta to read words of power until an altar shattered.

arcs.bequin: Leader of the Word Bearers allied with Queen Mab's Ministorum and the Blackwards. He sought a pariah to speak Enuncia against the King in Yellow, and forced Beta to read words of power until an altar shattered.

characters.epithet: A dark apostle's hunter of words

characters.name: Senefuru of Tizca
characters.title: Leader of the Immaterial College
characters.fate: Fought the graels at Mordaunt's hideout; outcome unknown.
characters.summary: A Thousand Sons sorcerer who binds the squabbling Immaterial College together. The College is a cabal of traitor and loyalist Astartes formed after Isstvan to fight 'the Tyrant'. Speaking the College's name summons it, as Ravenor learns.

arcs.bequin: A Thousand Sons sorcerer who binds the squabbling Immaterial College together. The College is a cabal of traitor and loyalist Astartes formed after Isstvan to fight 'the Tyrant'. Speaking the College's name summons it, as Ravenor learns.

characters.epithet: A sorcerer chaining legions together

characters.name: Thaddeus Saur
characters.title: Weapons-master of the Maze Undue
characters.fate: His conditioning by the King's agents made him lead the graels to Mam Mordaunt. He was then killed, apparently by Mordaunt at his own request.
characters.summary: Beta's combat instructor, whom she saved from Voriet. He signalled the dispersal during Ravenor's raid. Ravenor later took him on as an apparent amnesiac. In Penitent he joins Beta and Lightburn to infiltrate Mordaunt's tower, where his hidden conditioning betrays them.

arcs.bequin: Beta's combat instructor, whom she saved from Voriet. He signalled the dispersal during Ravenor's raid. Ravenor later took him on as an apparent amnesiac. In Penitent he joins Beta and Lightburn to infiltrate Mordaunt's tower, where his hidden conditioning betrays them.

characters.epithet: A sword-master turned beacon

characters.name: The Brass Thief
characters.title: Bound daemon assassin
characters.fate: Its attack on Ravenor's hideout ends when Slyte, through Thonius, kills its controlling psykers.
characters.summary: An ancient daemon bound into a gold-and-silver pyramid that unfolds into a clockwork body with "rhyming swords". Awakened by Culzean with sacrifices and directed by psykers, it is sent to kill Ravenor in Petropolis and slays Zeph Mathuin.

arcs.ravenor: An ancient daemon bound into a gold-and-silver pyramid that unfolds into a clockwork body with "rhyming swords". Awakened by Culzean with sacrifices and directed by psykers, it is sent to kill Ravenor in Petropolis and slays Zeph Mathuin.

characters.epithet: Clockwork shell, daemon heart

characters.name: The Saruthi
characters.title: Xenos race of 56-Izar
characters.fate: Their world 56-Izar is purged and subjected to Exterminatus once their Necroteuch is destroyed.
characters.summary: An eyeless, many-limbed alien race corrupted by a copy of the Necroteuch, from which they made their own "Xenoteuch". They build asymmetrical four-dimensional "tetrascapes" and travel through tetragates instead of ships. House Glaw bargains with them for the tome.

arcs.eisenhorn: An eyeless, many-limbed alien race corrupted by a copy of the Necroteuch, from which they made their own "Xenoteuch". They build asymmetrical four-dimensional "tetrascapes" and travel through tetragates instead of ships. House Glaw bargains with them for the tome.

characters.epithet: Asymmetry made flesh

characters.name: Toros Revoke
characters.title: Secretist enforcer
characters.fate: Killed by Ravenor after Nayl distracts him.
characters.summary: Trice's hyper-competent right hand, a yellow-eyed psyker and skilled user of Enuncia who silences anyone who learns too much. He shatters bones with spoken words.

arcs.ravenor: Trice's hyper-competent right hand, a yellow-eyed psyker and skilled user of Enuncia who silences anyone who learns too much. He shatters bones with spoken words.

characters.epithet: Every word a broken bone

characters.name: Waltur Aulay
characters.title: Ordo Malleus Inquisitor gone native
characters.fate: Revealed as an Inquisitor late in Penitent; seemingly set up for the next book.
characters.summary: Sent to infiltrate Sancour's aristocracy in search of a heretic. He took a cover identity as an engraver and so enjoyed it, and drink, that he lost contact with his ordo and became the drunk he pretended to be, one of Crookley's set.

arcs.bequin: Sent to infiltrate Sancour's aristocracy in search of a heretic. He took a cover identity as an engraver and so enjoyed it, and drink, that he lost contact with his ordo and became the drunk he pretended to be, one of Crookley's set.

characters.epithet: The mask that swallowed the man

characters.name: Ahenobarb
characters.title: Kinsky's minder
characters.fate: Killed by Patience Kys aboard the Hinterlight.
characters.summary: The burly minder who accompanies the psyker Kinsky as part of the Ministry team that betrays Ravenor at Bonner's Reach.

arcs.ravenor: The burly minder who accompanies the psyker Kinsky as part of the Ministry team that betrays Ravenor at Bonner's Reach.

characters.epithet: The wall beside the psyker

characters.name: Bakunin
characters.title: Hololithographer of Sunsable's Fair
characters.fate: Dragged into a warp vortex by the ghosts trapped in his pictures; his screaming image appears on every remaining hololith.
characters.summary: A kindly old portraitist with a travelling fair on Gudrun. He unknowingly bought a never-emptying vial of warp-tainted fixer, which kills people and traps them in his portraits.

arcs.eisenhorn: A kindly old portraitist with a travelling fair on Gudrun. He unknowingly bought a never-emptying vial of warp-tainted fixer, which kills people and traps them in his portraits.

characters.epithet: A portraitist captured in his own art

characters.name: Brytnoth
characters.title: Deathwatch Librarian
characters.fate: Fights alongside Eisenhorn on 56-Izar; his later fate is not recorded.
characters.summary: A Librarian of Watch Captain Cynewolf's Deathwatch kill-team on 56-Izar. He gives Eisenhorn the compact bolt pistol that Eisenhorn carries for over a century.

arcs.eisenhorn: A Librarian of Watch Captain Cynewolf's Deathwatch kill-team on 56-Izar. He gives Eisenhorn the compact bolt pistol that Eisenhorn carries for over a century.

characters.wargear: Gifted Eisenhorn a master-crafted bolt pistol
characters.epithet: Gift-giver in power armour

characters.name: Crookley
characters.title: Poet and occult salon host
characters.fate: Not recorded in available sources.
characters.summary: A drink-loving rebel poet whose circles trade forbidden ideas among Queen Mab's elite. Eisenhorn and Beta move through his scene undercover while hunting Freddy Dance.

arcs.bequin: A drink-loving rebel poet whose circles trade forbidden ideas among Queen Mab's elite. Eisenhorn and Beta move through his scene undercover while hunting Freddy Dance.

characters.epithet: Toasting heresy by candlelight

characters.name: Duboe
characters.title: Carnivora flect supplier
characters.fate: Released aboard the Hinterlight, he attacks the limited Ravenor and is killed by him.
characters.summary: A member of the Carnivora circus who supplied flects to dealers on Eustis Majoris. Captured by the team, he is taken to Flint, where his interrogation yields the words "Contract Thirteen".

arcs.ravenor: A member of the Carnivora circus who supplied flects to dealers on Eustis Majoris. Captured by the team, he is taken to Flint, where his interrogation yields the words "Contract Thirteen".

characters.epithet: The circus thread in the flect web

characters.name: Ebon Nastrand
characters.title: The Secretary of the Maze Undue
characters.fate: His fate after Ravenor's raid is unknown.
characters.summary: Head of the Maze Undue for over a century. He reacted strangely when Beta suggested the Cognitae were behind events, which foreshadows that he and all the staff were Cognitae.

arcs.bequin: Head of the Maze Undue for over a century. He reacted strangely when Beta suggested the Cognitae were behind events, which foreshadows that he and all the staff were Cognitae.

characters.epithet: The quiet hand behind the Maze

characters.name: Eleena Koi
characters.title: Distaff blank
characters.fate: Survives the fall of Spaeton House and stays with Eisenhorn through the hunt for Glaw.
characters.summary: A psychic blank of the Distaff who is at Eisenhorn's Gudrun estate when Glaw's mercenaries attack. She escapes with Eisenhorn and Aemos and helps rescue Medea.

arcs.eisenhorn: A psychic blank of the Distaff who is at Eisenhorn's Gudrun estate when Glaw's mercenaries attack. She escapes with Eisenhorn and Aemos and helps rescue Medea.

characters.epithet: One silence left after the slaughter

characters.name: Eskeen Hansaard
characters.title: Minister of Security, Urbitane
characters.fate: Last seen when the veterans' "cult" is broken; his later fate is not recorded.
characters.summary: The official in Urbitane on Sameter who asks Eisenhorn to investigate a string of apparent ritual murders. These turn out to be the work of traumatised Imperial Guard veterans, not Chaos cultists.

arcs.eisenhorn: The official in Urbitane on Sameter who asks Eisenhorn to investigate a string of apparent ritual murders. These turn out to be the work of traumatised Imperial Guard veterans, not Chaos cultists.

characters.epithet: The man who asked the right question

characters.name: Estrum
characters.title: Renegade Imperial Navy captain
characters.fate: Executed by Eisenhorn during the firefight at the saruthi exchange on KCX-1288.
characters.summary: Commander of a Battlefleet Scarus frigate wing who goes rogue to carry the Glaw cabal and its forces to their meeting with the saruthi.

arcs.eisenhorn: Commander of a Battlefleet Scarus frigate wing who goes rogue to carry the Glaw cabal and its forces to their meeting with the saruthi.

characters.epithet: A captain who sold his ships

characters.name: Faria
characters.title: Maze Undue classmate
characters.fate: A seeming clone of her is among the pariahs who confront Beta in the City of Dust.
characters.summary: One of Beta's fellow trainees at the Maze Undue and a better shot than her. In Penitent, Beta meets apparent copies of Faria and Judika serving the King in Yellow inside the City of Dust.

arcs.bequin: One of Beta's fellow trainees at the Maze Undue and a better shot than her. In Penitent, Beta meets apparent copies of Faria and Judika serving the King in Yellow inside the City of Dust.

characters.epithet: A familiar face in the wrong city

characters.name: Inquisitor Fenx
characters.title: Inquisitor
characters.fate: He and his retinue are slaughtered by Molotch in a trap set with Ballack's help.
characters.summary: An inquisitor on Tancred who takes over the hunt for Molotch when Ravenor is ordered to stand down. Betrayed by his own interrogator, his team is wiped out, proving Ravenor's hunch right and pushing him to go rogue.

arcs.ravenor: An inquisitor on Tancred who takes over the hunt for Molotch when Ravenor is ordered to stand down. Betrayed by his own interrogator, his team is wiped out, proving Ravenor's hunch right and pushing him to go rogue.

characters.epithet: The man who took Ravenor's hunt

characters.name: Javes Thysser
characters.title: Inquisitor, Ordo Xenos
characters.fate: Survives his encounter with Cherubael and reports it to Lord Rorken.
characters.summary: In Malleus's prologue his retinue is slaughtered by Cherubael, which then spares him, apologising for mistaking him for Eisenhorn. His report first casts suspicion on Eisenhorn.

arcs.eisenhorn: In Malleus's prologue his retinue is slaughtered by Cherubael, which then spares him, apologising for mistaking him for Eisenhorn. His report first casts suspicion on Eisenhorn.

characters.epithet: Spared by a daemon's mistake

characters.name: Lowink
characters.title: Astropath
characters.fate: Killed by the warp entity that manifests during the auto-seance on Malahite's corpse.
characters.summary: Eisenhorn's young, sickly astropath during the Necroteuch affair, his skull and arms studded with implant plugs. He is only a weak psyker, but he knows Eisenhorn's methods well enough to orchestrate the auto-seances that probe Eyclone's secrets.

arcs.eisenhorn: Eisenhorn's young, sickly astropath during the Necroteuch affair, his skull and arms studded with implant plugs. He is only a weak psyker, but he knows Eisenhorn's methods well enough to orchestrate the auto-seances that probe Eyclone's secrets.

characters.epithet: A frail voice in the empyrean

characters.name: Lupan
characters.title: Shopkeeper of the Blackwards Emporium
characters.fate: Not recorded in available sources.
characters.summary: Runs the Blackwards emporium Beta infiltrates as 'Laurael Raeside'. Among the books he sets out for her is one of Lilean Chase's journals, the cipher text that drives Penitent.

arcs.bequin: Runs the Blackwards emporium Beta infiltrates as 'Laurael Raeside'. Among the books he sets out for her is one of Lilean Chase's journals, the cipher text that drives Penitent.

characters.epithet: Dealer in dangerous curios

characters.name: Massimo Ricci
characters.title: Inquisitor, Ordo Xenos
characters.fate: Slain by Quixos on Farness Beta; a library on Hesperus is later named for him.
characters.summary: One of Lord Rorken's most valued subordinates, sent in Rorken's place to join the outlawed Eisenhorn's hunt for Quixos.

arcs.eisenhorn: One of Lord Rorken's most valued subordinates, sent in Rorken's place to join the outlawed Eisenhorn's hunt for Quixos.

characters.epithet: Rorken's proxy at the altar of the sun

characters.name: Pontifex Urba
characters.title: Senile Pontifex of Queen Mab
characters.fate: His subordinates' Enuncia conspiracy ended when the cathedral fell.
characters.summary: An aged head of the local Ecclesiarchy whose mind is eroding and whom his clergy sideline. During Beta's interrogation he has a vision and gives her a cryptic warning for Eisenhorn. Most of what he says is nonsense, but some of it is true.

arcs.bequin: An aged head of the local Ecclesiarchy whose mind is eroding and whom his clergy sideline. During Beta's interrogation he has a vision and gives her a cryptic warning for Eisenhorn. Most of what he says is nonsense, but some of it is true.

characters.epithet: A mad priest speaking true by accident

relationships.note: his church allied with the Word Bearers

characters.name: Raum Grumman
characters.title: Inquisitor, Ordo Hereticus
characters.fate: Beheaded by Quixos at Ferell Sidor on Farness Beta.
characters.summary: Neve's subordinate, sent as her proxy in the Eisenhorn matter. He joins Eisenhorn's cell of inquisitors hunting Quixos.

arcs.eisenhorn: Neve's subordinate, sent as her proxy in the Eisenhorn matter. He joins Eisenhorn's cell of inquisitors hunting Quixos.

characters.epithet: Sent as a proxy, fell for real

characters.name: Urisel Glaw
characters.title: Commander of the Glaw militia
characters.fate: Captured by Eisenhorn during the raid on the Glaw estate; he resists Inquisitorial torture and his final fate is not recorded.
characters.summary: Oberon's brother and leader of House Glaw's militia. Eisenhorn takes him prisoner, and his stubborn silence under torture shows the inquisitors that a larger plot is under way.

arcs.eisenhorn: Oberon's brother and leader of House Glaw's militia. Eisenhorn takes him prisoner, and his stubborn silence under torture shows the inquisitors that a larger plot is under way.

characters.epithet: Silent under the knife

locations.name: Hubris
locations.note: Icebound world whose population sleeps out the long winter in cryo-vaults; there Eisenhorn kills Eyclone and recruits Fischig and Bequin.

locations.name: Gudrun
locations.note: Helican capital world, home of House Glaw and later of Eisenhorn's estate; Glaw's mercenaries strike Eisenhorn there.

locations.name: Damask
locations.note: Frontier world where the Glaw cabal digs up saruthi tiles under Mandragore's supervision.

locations.name: KCX-1288
locations.note: Collapsing abandoned saruthi system whose tetrascape hosts the Necroteuch exchange.

locations.name: 56-Izar
locations.note: Saruthi core world invaded by an Inquisitorial task force and then subjected to Exterminatus.

locations.name: Essene
locations.note: Tobias Maxilla's ship, which carries Eisenhorn until it is destroyed after Osma's boarding.

locations.name: Saint Scythus
locations.note: Inquisitorial warship where Rorken convenes the inquisitors and the Malahite auto-seance summons a daemon.

locations.name: Sameter
locations.note: Declining agro-chemical world; in its hive Urbitane, Eisenhorn uncovers the veterans' ritual killings and loses his left hand.

locations.name: Lethe Eleven
locations.note: Where Eisenhorn breaks Beldame Sadia's cult at the cost of Sweydyr's life.

locations.name: Thracian Primaris
locations.note: Hive world and subsector capital; the Triumph parade there becomes the Thracian Atrocity.

locations.name: Eechan
locations.note: Agri world where Eisenhorn and Nayl pose as mutants to expose Lyko at a psyker auction.

locations.name: Cadia
locations.note: Fortress world where the Sons of Bael study the pylons and Osma arrests Eisenhorn.

locations.name: Cinchare
locations.note: Rogue mining world in the Halo Stars where Magos Bure guards the Pontius and destroys the Lith.

locations.name: Farness Beta
locations.note: World at the edge of the Eye of Terror where Eisenhorn's cell storms Ferell Sidor and kills Quixos.

locations.name: Durer
locations.note: Ophidian world where Fayde Thuring awakens the Titan Cruor Vult on the island of Miquol.

locations.name: Messina
locations.note: Headquarters of the Distaff, wiped out by Glaw's mercenaries.

locations.name: Promody
locations.note: One of seven ancient daemon-conquered worlds, where the team regroups with Ravenor.

locations.name: Jeganda
locations.note: Where the Essene is serviced and Fischig's betrayal springs Osma and Heldane's trap.

locations.name: Ghül (5213X)
locations.note: Capital of a long-dead daemon empire holding Yssarile's barque; Eisenhorn kills Glaw there.

locations.name: Eustis Majoris
locations.note: Polluted hive world and capital of the Angelus sub-sector, where the flect trade and the Enuncia conspiracy unfold.

locations.name: Petropolis
locations.note: Vast hive city on Eustis Majoris whose architecture was designed as a ritual pattern; much of it is devastated at the climax of Ravenor Returned.

locations.name: Flint
locations.note: Low-tech agri-world of beast-moots where Thonius loses his arm in a fight.

locations.name: Bonner's Reach
locations.note: Lawless trading port in Lucky Space where the Ministry agents spring their trap on Ravenor.

locations.name: Lucky Space
locations.note: Lawless frontier region where Ravenor's disappearance would draw little scrutiny.

locations.name: Mergent Worlds
locations.note: Warp-ruined worlds whose shattered glass becomes flects and whose tainted cogitators are smuggled under Contract Thirteen.

locations.name: Hinterlight
locations.note: Cynia Preest's stealth-equipped rogue trader ship, hijacked by Madsen and sent towards a star.

locations.name: Arethusa
locations.note: Sholto Unwerth's ship, Ravenor's transport from the end of the first novel.

locations.name: Oktober Country
locations.note: Kizary Thekla's ship, destroyed by Ravenor; earlier the vessel that teleported Molotch to safety.

locations.name: Malinter
locations.note: Backwater world where Ravenor fights the Divine Fratery and meets Eisenhorn.

locations.name: Tancred
locations.note: World hosting an Inquisition headquarters where Ravenor is ordered off Molotch's trail and Fenx's team is massacred.

locations.name: Utochre
locations.note: Ice-capped ocean world whose depths hide the Wych House.

locations.name: Wych House of Utochre
locations.note: Psychically charged house deep beneath Utochre's ice that guards a divinatory tri-portal; destroyed in the Tyranid incursion.

locations.name: Propylaeum Tripartite
locations.note: The three-sided warp door that throws the team across space and time and is finally used to banish Slyte.

locations.name: Listening Post Arethusa
locations.note: Outpost a thousand years in the past where the door strands Ravenor and a surgeon saves his life.

locations.name: Zenta Malhyde
locations.note: Site of the prologue dig where Ravenor's agents strike Molotch excavating Enuncia carvings.

locations.name: The Carnivora
locations.note: Circus on Eustis Majoris used as a flect-smuggling front, infiltrated by the team.

locations.name: Sancour
locations.note: Decaying Imperial world in the Angelus Subsector of the Scarus Sector, and the setting of both novels.

locations.name: Queen Mab
locations.note: Faded hive city in Sancour's southern hemisphere (Hercula prefecture), with a Victorian, French-tinged air, abandoned shipyards and saint-hallowed streets.

locations.name: The Maze Undue
locations.note: Cognitae-run training school for blanks posing as an Inquisition academy (name corrupted from 'maison dieu'); razed by Ravenor, its secret mirrors later let Beta into the City of Dust.

locations.name: Scholam Orbus
locations.note: Orphanage beside the Maze Undue where Beta was raised, watched by Medea as Sister Bismillah.

locations.name: The City of Dust
locations.note: The King in Yellow's vast extimate realm: a palace-city on an island in a tamed sea of warp, under a sky holding the Eye of Terror.

locations.name: The Below
locations.note: Abandoned buried strata and ossuaries beneath Queen Mab, home to mad anatomists, where Beta finds Renner and meets Comus.

locations.name: The Holloways
locations.note: Forbidden passages of Queen Mab patrolled by drug-burned veteran watchmen like Deathrow, which Beta uses to move unseen.

locations.name: Cathedral of Queen Mab
locations.note: Pilgrimage cathedral where the Ministorum and Word Bearers forced Beta to speak Enuncia, until it began to collapse.

locations.name: Villa Feverfugue
locations.note: Alace Quatorze's mansion, sought as a possible gateway to the City of Dust, where Teke kills Judika.

locations.name: Blackwards Emporium
locations.note: Antique shop of the Blackwards dynasty, guarded by animated poison-bladed dolls, where Beta found Lilean Chase's journal.
